notes: Container restart killed the revision workflow before it wrote anything; relaunched as two parallel agents with disjoint files (spec v1.1 / Sejmik storey S-2). 3D and plans agents resumed from their transcripts.

Cost/energy verifier added 2 hard failures: corrected mid cost 150.8–151.7 M PLN (> 150 cap) and real on-site PV ≈ 328 kWp (< 400 kWp required by M.12) — both are hard constraints in the revision brief, with numerical proof required.

New drawings: eco scheme on a section through the garden (PV, retention, GSHP, TABS, ventilation, biodiversity, KPIs), accessibility scheme with a storey matrix counted live from the room model (WC, refuge areas, lifts, induction loops — all storeys now complete), four idea axonometries for board 1.

Board drafts at true scale revealed layout issues early: 1:200 elevations had to be cropped to visible content (4 now fit one board); façade section 1:50 and eco scheme collide on board 8 — final allocation after plans arrive.
Shared post-processing (tools/postprodukcja.py): subtle presets that keep exposure; first aggressive version was rejected because it muddied shadows.
